question: Does persistent no-gradient spectral programming of shared mutation interaction weights predict effects at entirely unseen GB1 site-pairs better than fully optimized same-information additive and bilinear factorization baselines?
hypothesis: An evidence-gated spectral shared mutation-factor program yields >=5% lower held site-pair-weighted RMSE than strongest validation-selected converged conventional control in a distinct 55-site historical GB1 double-mutant landscape.

source.original_source_admission: Original full metadata ONLY and all four exact bytes verified; 1045 singles, 535917 double genotypes, 55 sites. No original count/fitness outcome values used for model fitting or scoring before prereg.
source.licensing: Original reprocessor repository MIT software license, underlying 2014 measured data redistribution rights not independently verified. No original source bytes republished.
source.public_prior_outcome_exposure: Published Olson 2014 experiment and prior analyses publicly known; this is PUBLIC DEV, not virgin blind or new physical-world first use.

data_and_split.label: Compute for each mutant log((Selection Count+0.5)/(Input Count+0.5)) - log((wildtype selection+0.5)/(wildtype input+0.5)). For each double, subtract the two corresponding single-mutant measured log-effects to form epistasis residual.
data_and_split.admission: Counts must be finite nonnegative integers (strict decimal), no zero-denominator due fixed pseudocount=0.5. Do not skip rows based on label magnitude or observed effect. Exclude only source-genotype pair rows whose parent single isn't in the verified 1045-member single roster; report count; require >=450000 eligible doubles.
data_and_split.unit: Entire unordered mutated position pair (site_i,site_j) across all mutation identities; never individual source row. No held site-pair labels or counts used in preprocessing.
data_and_split.split: SHA256('WSP198-OLSON55-SITEPAIR-v1\0'+min_site+'\0'+max_site), first 8 digest bytes big-endian modulo 100: FIT 0..69, VALID 70..84, DEV 85..99. Pre-frozen, no salt sweep or rebalancing.
data_and_split.minimums: At least 700 distinct FIT site pairs, 120 VALID site pairs, 120 DEV site pairs, 180000 FIT double genotypes, 25000 VALID double genotypes, 25000 DEV double genotypes, >=800 parent single mutant features.
data_and_split.source_normalization: From FIT double epistasis residuals only: subtract FIT residual mean and divide FIT population SD. FIT/VALID/DEV same transform. All controls and candidate use same single-parent effects, FIT doubles, VAILD hyperparam selection and kept DEV sealed until one score.
data_and_split.missing_and_corruption: No missing original data source; original CR-only 18 column format; fail closed on malformed genotype or counts, unexpected alternate, reference mismatch, duplicates, sources SHA mismatch, or insufficient independent groups.

candidate.name: No-gradient persistent spectral interaction weight programming
candidate.features: One native non-token position/allele address per mutation, 1045 possible state addresses, no seq tokenizer/pretrained embeddings.
candidate.train: Construct symmetric FIT-only observed epistasis residual adjacency W_ij = z_ij/sqrt(degree_i*degree_j), absent edges exactly zero. Program r orthogonal signed eigen-basis vectors using 25 deterministic normalized power iterations per component plus projection deflation; rank r in [2,4], deterministic trigonometric seed fixed 19811. Direct factor storage r*number_mutation_features, no gradient-descent updates or per-held-pair lookup table.
candidate.inference: Predict held epistasis residual as alpha*sqrt(degree_i*degree_j)*sum_k(lambda_k*v_ki*v_kj), alpha chosen from [0,0.5,1,2] on VALID site-pair-equal-weighted RMSE. Inference never reads a held edge's original numerical label.
candidate.selection: Select candidate rank and alpha by VALID site-pair-equal-weighted RMSE (tie prefer alpha0 and lower rank). No model change after DEV.

strong_conventional_controls.additive: Fully fitted per-mutation residual correction ridge coordinate descent over identical FIT doubles, regularization lambda [1,10], max 100 sweeps until <=1e-6 max coefficient delta; VALID selects.
strong_conventional_controls.bilinear_als: Regularized rank-[2,4] asymmetric U,V ALS over symmetric directed FIT edges, ridge lambda [1,10], max 50 full ALS sweeps; use mean of U_i.V_j and U_j.V_i for held prediction; ensure training objective relative improvement <=1e-4 over last two checkpoints or report unconverged. Same FIT observations, same native site/allele features; more adjustable parameters than spectral program.
strong_conventional_controls.selected: Strongest CONVERGED baseline chosen by minimum VALID site-pair-weighted RMSE. Do not claim fully fitted if optimization not converged. If no rank-[2,4] bilinear variants converge, mark comparator qualification incomplete and SCIENTIFIC_INVALID.
negative_controls: FIT residual labels shuffled across observed FIT genotype edges using fixed seed19831, keeping all matrix geometry, candidate rank/alpha selection VALID only
strong_conventional_controls.resource: At most 25 spectral power iterations per component; <=50 ALS sweeps per variant; at most 4 ALS variants. Run same FIT/VALID/DEV sets and record wall/process memory when available, candidate stored params and control params.

metrics.primary: Equal weight per held unordered site-pair group of mean squared normalized epistasis residual error; RMSE=sqrt(mean group MSE).
metrics.uncertainty: 2000 bootstrap resamples of held site-pair groups with replacement, deterministic seed 19841; 95% percentile CI of relative RMSE gain vs strongest converged conventional.
metrics.retention: Serialize and cold restore measured 1045 single effects before/after interaction factor learning; confirm no single effect changes and report exact roundtrip delta. This is an engineered frozen-weight test NOT genuine delayed interference retention.
metrics.cost: Record FIT/VALID/DEV source rows and independent site pairs, candidate/control factor dimensions, CPU runtime and peak RSS if available, source access time separately, no training efficiency claim without whole process comparison.
metrics.support_threshold: At least 5% lower held DEV RMSE than strongest converged conventional and bootstrap 95% lower gain >0, no single drift. Remains PUBLIC_DEV_SUPPORTED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_QUALIFICATION, never SCIENTIFIC_PASS without independent source and native owner qualification.
metrics.no_go: If strict data and convergence gates PASS but improvement fails, PUBLIC_DEV_NO_GO; preserve negative, stop tuning.
metrics.invalid: Source admission drift, data leakage, insufficient eligible rows/groups, missing strong baseline convergence, nonfinite outputs or unknown source license for redistribution: either FAIL_CLOSED or engineering INVALID; do not represent invalid as a science negative.
metrics.scientific_scope: Retrospective within-protein variant-site transfer from published Olson 2014; not a new physical intervention, model general intelligence, action-consequence learning, new organism transfer, or scientific proof of native Yggdrasil training.
